tasks.short: Collaborate on environmental science teaching and research issues.

steps.what: Locate current environmental science course, laboratory or research issue sources
inputs: actual current course or research records

steps.what: Collaborate with colleagues on actual teaching/research choices and capture actual working notes
outputs: actual collaborative choices, disagreements and teacher-captured working notes

steps.what: Write assigned collaborative recommendations and follow-up from actual working notes
inputs: actual collaborative choices, disagreements and teacher-captured working notes

loop.purpose: Draft assigned follow-up from actual checked collaboration notes
loop.input: teacher-captured choices, dissent, actual owners and agreed actions
loop.output: source-linked follow-up draft with missing assignments left explicit
loop.check: Teacher checks meaning, omitted disagreement, invented consensus and whether each recommendation/action was actually chosen
loop.stop: Unclear decision or two failed revisions returns affected text to manual writing
loop.why_not_simpler: Test native action fields first; varied technical recommendations need semantic drafting and checking

steps.what: Complete and check actual written recommendations and retain the internal follow-up record
inputs: actual collaborative choices, disagreements and teacher-captured working notes
outputs: checked saved actual collaborative recommendations and follow-up

tasks.design: Configure current issue-source links in {DOCS}/{PROJECT}, then draft only actually assigned follow-up from teacher-captured working notes. Retain collaboration, substantive decisions and complete written checks; ordinary internal saving is ungated with no saving.
tasks.previous_blocker: Issue-source navigation and descriptive follow-up typing can repeat.
tasks.enabler_now: Native links and bounded note-grounded drafting can reduce preparation.
tasks.still_hard: Research and teaching choices require real colleague judgement.
tasks.human_edge: The teacher preserves a scientific disagreement that changes the next action.
tasks.altitude: Less source navigation and descriptive follow-up typing.

evidence.claim: Model knowledge: note-grounded drafting can assist actual collaborative follow-up while technical choices and meaning checks remain human.

assumptions: Provisional source15 removes three locating points and draft20 removes four descriptive typing points after retained review. Actual note capture is counted within55, not a free transcript. Formal follow-up is only included if actually assigned; remove/reweight otherwise.

Course/research owners supply actual source id/version and status; teacher records actual decisions, dissent and assignments during discussion. Missing context is clarified manually. Existing links/templates receive no credit. Shared internal workspace is the actual delivery route here, without invented extra email or approval work.
unknowns: Does this teacher own the actual written collaborative follow-up?
research_questions: Can draft follow-up preserve disagreement and avoid inventing assignments?

incremental.description: Maintain issue-source links and follow-up meaning checks.

time_saved_range_pct.basis: High removes3 source-navigation plus4 descriptive typing points minus0.9 upkeep=6.1. Low: a new joint laboratory problem needs fresh technical recommendations, leaving only2 familiar source-navigation points and0.5 descriptive typing points removable, minus0.9=1.6. Collaboration, capture and full written checks retain their time.

tasks.short: Prepare and deliver environmental science lectures.

steps.what: Choose hazardous-waste, industrial-safety or environmental-toxicology lecture objectives and accurate examples
outputs: chosen lecture objectives, sources and examples

steps.what: Prepare lectures by assembling selected subject diagrams, explanations and exercises
inputs: chosen lecture objectives, sources and examples

steps.what: Check whole lecture for actual subject accuracy and retain the final internal material
inputs: chosen lecture objectives, sources and examples
outputs: checked saved final environmental science lecture

steps.what: Deliver lectures to actual undergraduate or graduate students and answer questions
inputs: checked saved final environmental science lecture
outputs: actual lecture delivery and learner responses

steps.what: Write and check actual assigned lecture observations and follow-up notes
inputs: actual lecture delivery and learner responses
outputs: checked saved actual lecture follow-up notes

tasks.design: Configure reuse of selected current lecture sections and diagrams in {DOCS}/{LMS}. Keep subject/example selection, actual adaptation, complete accuracy checks, lecture delivery and assigned fresh follow-up notes; ordinary internal saves receive no saving or self-gate.
tasks.previous_blocker: Stable subject diagrams and lecture sections can be assembled repeatedly.
tasks.enabler_now: Native selected-section reuse can remove assembly without choosing scientific explanations.
tasks.still_hard: Learners need accurate explanation of hazards, dose/response and uncertainty.
tasks.human_edge: The teacher identifies a misunderstanding that would lead to unsafe interpretation.
tasks.altitude: Less lecture assembly; teaching decisions stay unchanged.

evidence.claim: Model knowledge: selected lecture-section reuse can reduce preparation while technical accuracy and actual teaching remain human.

assumptions: Provisional preparation30 removes nine stable section/diagram assembly points; twenty-one actual adaptation points remain, plus full final checks10. Existing reuse receives zero new credit. Material/source owners supply actual section revision, subject source, units and applicability; missing/current content is prepared manually.

Teacher supplies real learner observations after delivery; follow-up notes only if actually assigned, otherwise drop/reweight. No competence inferred from attendance and no separate material send or grade transfer invented. Ordinary saves stay in retained checking/record time.
unknowns: Which subject sections are already reused and which need current updates?
research_questions: Can reuse preserve current hazard/toxicology qualifications rather than copying obsolete examples?

incremental.description: Maintain lecture-section sources, units and revision applicability.

time_saved_range_pct.basis: High removes9 repeat lecture-assembly points minus0.7 upkeep=8.3. Low: a new hazardous-waste topic needs fresh content and examples, leaving only3 stable method-diagram points reusable, minus0.7=2.3. Selection, adaptation, complete accuracy checks, delivery and actual notes retain their time.
